description: Re-pack and save a scene, optionally to another path (save-as). The mutation tools save by themselves: use this only for save-as via newPath, or to re-canonicalize a hand-edited .tscn. Overwrites silently. A newPath file gets no uid of its own. Returns: scenePath (loaded) and savedScenePath (written, confirmed on disk); warnings leads if the save dropped content. Errors while a runtime session is live on this project.

newPath.description: Save to a different path (relative to project) instead of overwriting the original

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: save_scene

savedScenePath.description: The file that was written. Equal to scenePath unless newPath was given.
